title: HypixelReplayWho
body:
# Command: /replaywho

Only works in replays but of course you can do it wherever you want![howitworks](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b19712b82910f04d48aa9c291be7babd3ffd9926.png)

use /replaywho in replays ,it send text to your client like the real /who cmd (ONLINE: XXX, XXXX, XXXXX...)

Thats it.
